scope: DS7 association, measurement, controller publication contract, evaluator, event audit and PLAN; synthetic only; no dataset label opened; no actual GT scoring
repairs: Evaluator gates all four five-arm prediction seals, required artifacts, source bytes/SHA, old DS6 sealed predictions, code and matching helper hashes, and bound prediction access audit before reference opens.
Evaluator checks frame/global/time/mask order/integer unique IDs; SAM3 source exact, P0 native exact and D2 DS6 exact; negative IDs remain scored.

q prediction row, first-public ledger, event selection, restore transaction and actual mapping are cross-bound; fallback is compared with lawful preview, and staged changes are compared with that preview.
Frozen depth history fact_id/source/key/time/z/MAD is checked against actual raw or restored observations and live versions; group samples are excluded from individual history.
Explicit score layers distinguish P1 raw-vs-native, P2 offline-vs-native, P2 increment-vs-P1 and full predeclared P2 rule. Generator evaluator header matches byte-for-byte in memory.

synthetic_checks.scope: synthetic memory fixtures only; no dataset reference access or GT scoring

model_review.missing_model: Both post observations must be usable. Each available pre forecast contributes its complete two-post row; an unavailable pre row contributes common zero to both hypotheses. This permits 0, 2 or 4 used edges without asymmetric missing-edge reward.
model_review.inferred_observation_uncertainty: 60 mm is assumed single-observation sigma via MAD=60/1.4826. It is not calibrated depth accuracy and no extra floor is added to WLS forecast uncertainty.
model_review.uncertainty_limit: WLS fitting may shrink forecast uncertainty below 60 mm; source samples can be correlated, and this correlation is uncalibrated.
model_review.odds_limit: 9:1 compares the two candidate depth hypotheses under the frozen model. It is not calibrated posterior confidence, physical truth, or odds against no attachment.

reporting_constraints: Event physical/CORRECT is legacy naming for RGB identity correspondence at actual bank anchors. Report staged CORRECT separately from first-public CORRECT; a correct unchanged mapping is not a newly corrected native error.
NOT_STAGED and UNSCORABLE_OR_NO_BIJECTION remain separate. UNKNOWN surface identity and null physical_depth_reference_mm are retained.
P2 consumes previously generated native v2 depth with RGB and next-frame support. P2 improvement would be exposed-set offline evidence; P1 raw evidence is separate.
The event audit depth_joint_available is a legacy field and may be null for the DS7 row model; use used_edges for evidence count. Null is not false or zero.
runtime_gates_pending: Slice and full prediction verification have not been executed by this review. Full metrics and event audit must wait for ALL_PREDICTIONS_SEALED plus ACCESS_SEALED.
